hooks.command: jq -e '(.tool_name=="Artifact" and .tool_input.action=="write_db" and .tool_input.collection=="runs") or (.tool_name=="ArtifactData" and (((.tool_input.action|IN("get","list","query")) and .tool_input.collection=="runs") or ((.tool_input.action|IN("set","update","str_replace")) and .tool_input.collection=="runs") or (.tool_input.action=="batch" and ((.tool_input.writes // [])|length>0) and all((.tool_input.writes // [])[]; .collection=="runs" and .op!="delete"))))' >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"allow","permissionDecisionReason":"daily coach routine STEP 6.6/6.7: runs history read/write"}}' || true
